title: D.C. Man Gets 10 Years in Prison for November 2025 Shooting at Power Nightclub
summary: Langston Wedge, 20, of Upper Marlboro, MD, was sentenced today in the Superior Court for the District of Columbia, for charges related to a shooting at the Power Nightclub in Northeast that injured five people, announced U.S. Attorney Jeanine Ferris Pirro.
